item.tib: mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol las 'khor ba'i zhen ldog ro snyoms gdams pa gnad sgyu ma bsgom thabs 'khrul pa rang grol
item.coloph: ces rdzogs pa chen (po) mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol gyi rgyad las/ sgya ma bsgom thabs 'khrul pa rangagrol 'di ni/ dus snyigs ma'i kun grol grags pa bdag la bstan sbyin rtsa grogs las slob rnams kyi snga phyi kun du gsung gis bskul ba dang*/ nye bar g.yung drung bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs chen po rab brten slob dpon che chung 'bangs kyi zhabs 'degs ches cher bsgrabs pa bzhin/ shar phyogs rgyal mo rong gi yongs 'dus dga' ldan gling chos grang dus kyi pho nya'i stong gsum 'bras ldanaM gyi dus brtsam (brtsams) pa'o//
